issues.on_page: Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds
issues.issue: Governmental funds are modified cash basis, not GAAP. They are recorded with fund balances because the statement rolls fund balance forward (457,761 + 304,179 - 290,667 = 471,273). A defensible choice, but the basis label is an assumption.

A CDBG loan repayment is a collection of loan principal and may not be revenue (it could be other financing). It is in 'other' with review. A person may want to decide how to treat it; decision_needed has no entry for it.

issues.on_page: Grants and contributions 48,437 (Statement of Activities p3: 48,015 capital grants and contributions, Environment and leisure)
issues.issue: The grantor isn't stated. If this is a government grant it would be intergovernmental/state aid or federal grants (already marked review). The same applies to detail[8] (Recreation, 48,015) and detail[10] (Library, 422).
Broad 'Intergovernmental' group assumed to be highway allocation; likely, but not printed (already marked review).
